normalized.result: The visible "Edit bookmark" button feels clearer to me. My main worry with clicking the whole card to edit is that, most of the time, when I click a saved bookmark I actually want it to take me to the original page — that's the everyday action. If the whole card opens an edit form instead, I'd lose the natural way to just go read the thing. So I'd keep a distinct "Edit" button for changing details, and let clicking the bookmark itself open the link. That keeps the two actions from stepping on each other.
